title: UPSC CSE - Logical Reasoning - Sitting Arrangement
subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 1. Three persons A, B and C are standing in a queue not necessarily in the same order. There are 4 persons between A and B, and 7 persons between B and C If there are 11 persons ahead of C and 13 behind A, what could be the minimum number of persons in the queue?
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 2. Eight students A, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table, equidistant from each other, facing the centre of the table, not necessarily in the same order. B and D sit neither adjacent to C nor opposite to C. A sits in between E and D, and F sits in between B and H. Which one of the following is definitely correct?
options: B sits in between A and G
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 3. Six persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting equidistant from each other around a circular table (facing the centre of the table). Consider the Question and two Statements given below: Question: Who is sitting on the immediate left of A? Statement—1: B is sitting opposite to C and D is sitting opposite to E. Statement—2: F is sitting on the immediate left of B. Which one of the following is correct in respect of the Question and the Statements?
options: Statement—I alone is sufficient to answer the Question
Statement—2 alone is sufficient to answer the Question
Both Statement—I and Statement—2 are sufficient to answer the Question
Both Statement—I and Statement—2 are not sufficient to answer the Question
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 4. A is 16th from the left end in a row of boys and V is 18th from the right end. G is 11th from A towards the right and 3rd from V towards the right end. How many boys are there in the row?
options: Cannot be determined due to insufficient data
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 5. A person is standing on the first step from the bottom of a ladder. If he has to climb 4 more steps to reach exactly the middle step, how many steps does the ladder have?
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 6. Four children are sitting in a row. A is occupying the seat next to B but not next to C. If C is not sitting next to D, who is/are occupying seat/seats adjacent to D?
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 7. Five people A, B, C, D and E are seated about a round table. Every chair is spaced equidistant from adjacent chairs. (i) C is seated next to A. (ii) A is seated two seats from D. (iii) B is not seated next to A. Which of the following must be true?
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning
